detail.longDescription: Built fail2zig because I like fail2ban's log-to-ban model but wanted a smaller runtime with explicit limits on the work attacker controlled input can cause. fail2zig is a single static binary with bounded parsers instead of a regex engine, SQLite-backed durable state, and nftables enforcement directly through netlink. Also has the ability to inspect and migrate existing fail2ban configurations. I just release 0.4.0 today which is the point where I'm more comfortable putting it in front of more people. Source: https://github.com/ul0gic/fail2zig Wouldn't mind feedback from people running fail2ban today, including reasons you would not switch.
